svg.title: Photo app updated architecture with async queue
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing Svelte frontend, NestJS API gateway, NestJS auth service, Go image worker consuming from Valkey queue, PostgreSQL, MinIO, all deployed via ArgoCD on k3s

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the Svelte frontend do?')
sendPrompt('What does the NestJS API gateway do?')
sendPrompt('How does the NestJS auth service work?')
sendPrompt('How does Valkey work as a job queue?')
sendPrompt('Why does the Go worker poll the queue instead of using gRPC?')
sendPrompt('Why use MinIO instead of S3?')
